root_cause.text: In ishtp_bus_remove_all_clients, the code unconditionally dereferences cl->device->reference_count when warm_reset is true, but cl->device can be NULL if a warm reset occurs while clients are still being enumerated, leading to a NULL pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `cl->device &&` before the dereference in the condition `if (warm_reset && cl->device && cl->device->reference_count)`. The commit description explicitly states: "During a warm reset flow, the cl->device pointer may be NULL if the reset occurs while clients are still being enumerated. Accessing cl->device->reference_count without a NULL check leads to a kernel panic." The call trace shows the crash at ishtp_bus_remove_all_clients.
